about: GOLDEN WEAPON DROPS (Dom 2026-10-28: 'we have endless sand, so it's good if we have good weapons and everything that drops'). A rare weapon lies in the world as a glowing pickup; the hero walks onto it (or taps its ring: the tap disc exists only while the ring is between `pickup.tapTopFrac` and `pickup.tapBottomFrac` of the screen height, so it can never sit under the left stick, the STRIKE cluster, roll or guard, nor the bars) and it is his for a limited number of CHARGES (one charge per blow he lands). One pickup = one power: `damageMul` (his blows hurt that much more, at once, mid-fight) and a golden `tint` on the weapon he holds. At 0 charges it is spent and he reverts to the weapon he had (the boss-weapon reward of data/progression.json). NO NEW ART (Dom): a row names a src/fight/weapon-defs.json id (`weapon`); a row drops only while that id is one the hero can draw (src/fight/scene.ts CARRIED_WEAPONS: today longsword, gladius, cleaver), so `plasma-spear` (trident) and `cursed-hammer` (maul) sit dormant, fully specified, until OpenTrident packs a hero GLB for them, then they drop with no code change. The drawn mesh is the rig built at load (corpse-run.json says the same), so a pickup tints and powers the weapon in his hand now and, if it is a different weapon id, draws as that weapon from the next page load. SOURCES (`drops`): a boss kill rolls `bossKill.chanceByStar[star]` (the star level of the boss, data/stars.json) and drops a row of tier up to `tierByStar[star]` within `scatterMetres` of the corpse; `roaming.points` are fixed pickups at a distance and bearing from the pit's centre inside a biome ring (data/rings.json), taken ones come back after `respawnSeconds`; `packChest` is the later hook for mob packs (off; the Pit Crawl and trash-mob lanes call dropGolden(position, tier) from src/zone/golden-drops.ts and listen on onPickup). Roaming points keep `clearanceMetres` outside every boss's leash circle (checked at load against the zone's spots and in test/golden-weapons.test.mjs), so a pickup never pulls the hero into a fight. The power is applied in the sim step: each blow the hero lands takes damage * (damageMul - 1) more off the boss in that same tick (never to a kill: the sim's own blow decides the kill) and spends one charge; the blow that spends the last charge still gets it, the next is plain. A held golden weapon is lost where the hero dies, as a ground pickup with the charges it had left (the corpse run's pile of coins and boss weapon is separate and untouched). Saved as the optional `golden` field of the progression save (src/progression.ts); a save without it loads as before. Rows are checked by src/sim/validate.js (keys) and src/fight/golden-check.ts validateGolden (values), at load. Balance is its own (not Armagedom's).
